entities.name: Mustafa Mümin Aksoy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mustafa Mümin Aksoy Paşa, also known as Gavûr Mümin, was a member of the Kuva-yi Milliye, the irregular Turkish nationalist forces that fought in the Turkish War of Independence. He was also part of the Turkish Armed Forces. Aksoy was the son of Osmanzade İbrahim Bey', a nephew of Izmir's mayor Hacı Hasan Bey.

entities.name: Mustafa Mümin Aksoy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mustafa Mümin Aksoy Paşa, also known as Gavûr Mümin, was a member of the Kuva-yi Milliye, the irregular Turkish nationalist forces that fought in the Turkish War of Independence. He was also part of the Turkish Armed Forces. Aksoy was the son of Osmanzade İbrahim Bey', a nephew of Izmir's mayor Hacı Hasan Bey.
